tagline: Tracking the volatility of future returns based on portfolio allocation.

story.description:
For this project we created a dashboard to visualize relative risk between different classes of securities. The dashboard also allows a user to analyze the relative risk of their portfolio based on their allocation to different classes of securities and compare to different allocations.

This dashboard is deployed on AWS using AWS Amplify and the backend is hosted on AWS Lambda and connected to the front end using API Gateway. This makes our app 100% serverless allowing for practically unlimited scalability and high availability.
